lines.text: Made a photo? You took it!
Many learners say: I made a photo of Ana.
Better: I took a photo of Ana.
Took! He took a photo of me.

data.wrong: I made a photo of Ana.
data.right: I took a photo of Ana.

native.tip: Muchos dicen “hacer una foto”; en inglés es “take a photo”, como “tomar una foto”.
native.caption: ¿Dices “I made a photo of Ana.”? 📸 Muchos dicen “hice una foto”, pero en inglés: “I took a photo of Ana.” ¡Escucha a Ama y repite! Practica más en la app Lexkite.
